The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4498 BBY''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Post-Manderon period|era]] that followed the [[Manderon Period]]. By that year, [[Tangan Industries]] had completed a full mining colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iol]], which expanded into three cities scattered across the planet over the next few centuries.<ref name="Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
